intro.line: Three stories now, each in its own plane. Eldraine first: castles, knights, and a king who is not what he seems.
Not every tale ends in glory.
Every card in Eldraine has a story, and some of them are lies.

finale.line: Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way.
Oko's stories are over. The realm is still its own, and Eldraine goes back to knights and quests.
Recorded: Eldraine, Theros and Ikoria all got their ending. Another war is not far off.

villainFinale.line: My advisors recommend I let them eat you.
In this version, the trickster stays on the throne, and the tale is his to tell.

battles.title: Every Card Has a Story
battles.blurb: Rowan Kenrith and her brother come home to Eldraine. Oko's court is already in the castle.

scene.line: Not every tale ends in glory.
Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value.
Adventures: cast the Adventure half first, it goes to exile, and later you can cast the creature from exile.

villainScene.line: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.
While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

hero.half: Cast the Adventure first, creature later.

battles.title: The Questing Beast
battles.blurb: The Questing Beast gathers the wild against Elspeth's faithful. Both sides are hungry.

scene.line: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.
Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.
Food: a Food token, an artifact you can sacrifice for 2 mana to gain 3 life. Many cards want food on the table.

villainScene.line: Even in her absence, the light Elspeth kindled in our hearts never faltered.
Every footstep is a prayer, every road a temple.

hero.half: Use Food for life when the race is close.

battles.title: Back from the Underworld
battles.blurb: Elspeth walks out of the underworld the hard way. Its dead are happy to follow.

scene.line: For her, I would gladly die again.
I bring a dawn that no night can follow.
Escape: cast it from the graveyard by paying its escape cost and exiling other cards from your graveyard. The graveyard is a second hand.

villainScene.line: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.
Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

hero.half: Fill your graveyard to pay for escape.

battles.title: The Nightmare Muse
battles.blurb: The twins meet Ashiok, whose dreams go all the way to Eldraine's doors.

scene.line: This sword is Sunrise. The other is Dawn. They mark the beginning of my days but the end of yours.
Every dream is a doorway.
Planeswalkers: attack them directly. A walker you ignore will bury you in card advantage.

villainScene.line: I bring a flood that nothing can withstand.
The Underworld erodes memory, identity, and eventually the physical form, leaving only crumbling statues called misera—hollow monuments to mortal futility.

hero.half: Attack the walker before it takes over.

battles.title: Monsters of Ikoria
battles.blurb: Vivien stands up for Ikoria's monsters. Lukka bonds with them and is not asking permission.

scene.line: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.
Mutate: cast a mutating creature onto a non-Human creature you own. The two become one, with all the abilities and the new top creature's stats.

villainScene.line: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

hero.half: Mutate onto a creature that already attacks well.

battles.title: Oko Food
battles.blurb: Autumn 2019: the green-blue Food deck that everyone built, against knights with big plans.

cards.name: Shepherd of the Flock // Usher to Safety

scene.line: Find him a weapon as big as his dreams.
His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.
Food makes your Oko hit harder and your life total hard to burn through. Keep him alive.

villainScene.line: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.
What size advantage? They never even see me coming.

hero.half: Protect Oko; food is not for burning.

battles.title: Temur Mutate
battles.blurb: Spring 2020: a mutate deck against big green ramp.

deck.name: Gruul Ramp
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Wilderness Reclamation is not in this act's sets, so this is a ramp deck of the same era.

scene.line: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
Mutate onto something that is already attacking. Keep your counters ready for their big finishers.

villainScene.line: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

hero.half: Hold counters for their big plays.

battles.title: Oko, Thief of Crowns
battles.blurb: Oko took the crowns and turned a king into an elk. Elspeth and the Kenriths aim to get them back.

scene.line: Duty and honor are reasons enough, but beating you will also be a pleasure.
Even when hope is but a small flame fighting the night, I will serve the absent king.
Kill his Food, kill Oko, kill whatever he turns into an elk. Do not give him time.

villainScene.line: My advisors recommend I let them eat you.
Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way.

hero.low: He is turning us into elk...
hero.half: Attack Oko the turn he lands.

half.line: The king will not be amused.

battles.title: Fires of Invention
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a red and white pile that casts two spells for the price of one.

archive.what: A red and white deck that used Fires of Invention to cast two spells per turn on a limited mana budget.
archive.why: Cheap, efficient spells and a free-cast engine made it a fast, resilient attacker in a format with many Food and Adventure decks.
archive.beat: Kill the engine pieces early and race; the deck wants to untap with Fires on the table.
archive.after: Throne of Eldraine's Standard seat was taken over by Theros Beyond Death and then Ikoria later that year and in 2020.

deck.name: Fires of Invention
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way.
Kill the engine before it spends your turn for you.

villainScene.line: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.

after.line: Recorded: Throne of Eldraine's Standard seat was taken over by Theros Beyond Death and then Ikoria later that year and in 2020.
